## create

Create Skill. `POST /automation/skills`

Create a skill (and its version 1). slug is derived from the title when omitted; an explicit slug that already exists returns 409.

goal (Beta, optional): structured goal stored on the version. An invalid goal returns 422 {"detail": {"code": "invalid_goal", "errors": [{path, code, message}]}}; 409 goal_unavailable while goals are not yet available.

```php
$result = $sendseven->aiSkills()->create(title: 'title', description: 'description', body: 'body');
```

## import

Import Skills. `POST /automation/skills/import`

Import skills in the seed format {slug?, title, description, mode?, skill, tool_allowlist?, goal?, attachment_instruction?} (an omitted goal / attachment_instruction keeps the existing value on update). An existing slug gets a new version when its content changed (updated), otherwise it is reported as unchanged. Invalid items are reported in errors without stopping the others.

```php
$result = $sendseven->aiSkills()->import(body: '...');
```

- Scopes: `automation:create`, `automation:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$body` | `mixed` | yes | The request body |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SkillImport`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/AI%20Skills/import_skills_api_v1_automation_skills_import_post)

## delete

Delete Skill. `DELETE /automation/skills/{skill_id}`

Delete a skill. A skill still linked to an agent or referenced by a flow is archived instead (action: "archived"); otherwise it is deleted with all its versions (action: "deleted").

```php
$result = $sendseven->aiSkills()->delete(skillId: 'skill_id');
```

## update

Update Skill. `PATCH /automation/skills/{skill_id}`

Update a skill. A title, description, body, tool_allowlist, goal or attachment_instruction change (null clears either) creates a new immutable version; an omitted goal / attachment_instruction is carried forward. default_mode / is_archived only change the skill. Invalid goal → 422 invalid_goal (see create).

```php
$result = $sendseven->aiSkills()->update(skillId: 'skill_id');
```
